newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambian stocks week - Volumes dive in thin market.
newsitem.headline: Zambian stocks week - Volumes dive in thin market.

text.p: Traded volumes fell on the Lusaka Stock Exchange last week, exchange officials said.
They said volume fell to 5,585 shares valued at 301.858 kwacha compared with 61,099 shares worth 839,207 kwacha in the previous week.
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 12 kwacha on turnover of 2,535 shares worth 30,420 kwacha.
Farmer House remained steady at 220 kwacha and saw 50 trades valued at 11,000 kwacha, while Chilanga Cement, steady at 52 kwacha, saw 1,000 shares worth 52,000 kwacha changing hands.
The other listed companies -- Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines and Rothmans -- saw no trades last week.
